waybackify cache [flags] [command]

Cache-store ops: add · fill · crawl · verify

The cache-store command group — populate, complete, and verify the
hermetic wayback cache image (the archive of record):

  add       fetch ONE capture (+ its requisites) into a cache root
  fill      drive a whole ledger to full asset closure (bulk, resumable)
  crawl     drive documents to a dynamic-completeness fixpoint (browser)
  verify    check a cache root against its own sidecars (fsck)

The remastered standalone tier lives under `remaster` and the bucket
projection under `bucket`.

Run `waybackify cache <verb> --help` for a verb's full surface.

Flags:
  --help|-h   Show help

Commands:
  add         Fetch one capture into a local bucket image
  fill        Fetch every capture a ledger references into a cache root
  crawl       Crawl documents to a dynamic-completeness fixpoint
  verify      Verify a cache root against its own sidecars

part of the wayback mirror tooling
